title: IPC method
description: THE CLOSED CATALOGUE of request methods. A name outside this set is answered ProtocolUnsupported and the connection stays; a name in the admin domain arriving on the data socket is answered CapabilityDenied before dispatch (ADR-0037). Each name's authority domain and required capability are stated in LOCAL-IPC.md §Method catalogue and mirrored by one table in `crates/api/ipc-protocol`; the schema-agreement test binds the two. Minors add names; a removal or rename is a major.
